note: FIXTURE LADDER — synthetic, for tests and local development ONLY (fixture tenant Campus Alpha). A 1-minute level-0 clock and 1- and 2-minute rungs with approvers named FIXTURE_VP and a fixture.test domain: this shape exists so it can never be mistaken for a campus's real escalation policy, because at some point someone will copy it. The real ladder is a P2 decision (principal and VPs), recorded in writing in sprint-3/research.md Spike Results, and loaded via ESCALATION_LADDER_DIR as <dir>/<tenant_id>.json. A worker configured with this file is a worker under test.
